about: What lib/layer-registry/layerPublication.js writes (mappingLayers ML3-a/b), as DATA. sssomSchemaReleaseText: R-e, the sssom_version enum admits only 1.0 | 1.1 (measured: '1.1.0a5' fails sssom validate), so the alpha the 1.1 slots were validated against is named in a declared extension. machineProducerKindList: the registered machine layers are judge layers (measured 2026-10-25: 45 of 45 member blocks inferred). droppedMachineColumnList: per-bridge match fields, whose CURIE prefix (EDUcoreHub) can name only one hub per curie_map while a version spans two hubs. legacySubjectExpansionPattern / legacyHubSourcePattern: what the pre-ML3 per-block export wrote (bridge-framework.js), kept declared under legacy_curie_map and as object_source. publicFilterFragmentPrefix: a filtered public rendering's mapping_set_id is the version URI plus this fragment and the filter digest (TQ Q37). authorIdSeparator: the SSSOM/TSV multivalued cell separator. subjectLabelPropertyNameBySubjectPrefix (ML3.1 Q42, table ruled by AMBER_JOURNEY 2026-10-26 O-2): the node property, WRITTEN BY THE FORGE, that holds each standard's OWN name for an element; subject_label is that property's value read verbatim (first value) from the gold, never composed; a subject whose node lacks it gets an empty cell and is counted in the render report. hubBundleTokenByHubName (ML3.1c, TQ Q8): which forge bundle each hub's cards come from, so the card download can refuse a hub on the licence-hold list by name; a hub missing here is refused, never guessed. publicationFileKindList (ML3.1c): every file published under downloadArtifacts/<gold>/ for the mapping sets and the cards, classified by the FIRST relativePathPattern it matches (named groups carry layerKey, versionTag, standardKey, hubSegment, hubReleaseSegment); publicationIndex.js refuses a file of no kind.

subjectLabelPropertyNameBySubjectPrefix.about: subject CURIE prefix -> node property; SIF xpath (its XPath, on the field instances the rows carry), Ed-Fi path (the dotted name), the PESC XSD releases, SEDM and MedBiquitous name (the publisher's element name), PESC_LD termCurie (the TAP row's term), the OpenAPI family and JEDx/LIF path (the forge's stored schema+property rendering)

hubBundleTokenByHubName.about: hubName (as the HubDefinition and every card state it) -> the downloadArtifactsRules.json bundleToken of the forge that builds the hub
